issues: src/lib/ocr.ts is corrupted/invalid TypeScript: it contains literal unmerged diff markers ('-' and '+' prefixed lines, and a trailing '*** End Patch' marker) instead of valid source code. This breaks TypeScript compilation (`tsc --noEmit` reports TS1109/TS1005 errors at ocr.ts:5-11), breaks `expo export` for both android and web platforms, and causes __tests__/ocr.test.ts to fail to even parse ('Unexpected token (5:7)'). The whole file needs to be rewritten as valid TypeScript implementing recognizeReceiptText and parseReceipt as specified.

src/lib/backup.ts is missing the createBackup, restoreBackup and validateBackupStructure exports entirely — it only contains imports and an `enforcePassphrasePolicy` stub. This is a severe regression of existing, previously-passing functionality: __tests__/acceptance/m4.test.ts ('TypeError: (0 , _backup.createBackup) is not a function') and __tests__/acceptance/m5.test.ts ('TypeError: (0 , _backup.validateBackupStructure) is not a function') now fail, and __tests__/categories.test.ts's backup round-trip test fails for the same reason. The task explicitly requires keeping all existing tests passing and extending backup/restore to include categories — instead the backup/restore implementation appears to have been deleted. Restore createBackup/restoreBackup (encrypting Receipts, MileageEntries, Settings, photos as before) and add validateBackupStructure in src/lib/validation.ts (as planned in step 4), then extend both to include the new 'categories' key as described in the task.

Given the above, 6 of 17 Jest test suites fail (ocr.test.ts, categories.test.ts, m4.test.ts, m5.test.ts, and others depending on backup), and expo export (both android and web) and tsc all fail in static validation — none of the blocking static validation checks pass.
feedback: The submission is incomplete/broken: src/lib/ocr.ts contains raw unresolved diff/patch markers instead of real code (a botched patch application), and src/lib/backup.ts is missing its core createBackup/restoreBackup/validateBackupStructure implementation that previously existed and is required by milestone 4 and 5 acceptance tests. Fix ocr.ts to be valid TypeScript per the plan (recognizeReceiptText + parseReceipt), restore/implement backup.ts's createBackup/restoreBackup extended with the categories field, and add validateBackupStructure to validation.ts (extended to accept the optional categories shape). After these fixes, rerun tsc, expo export (android & web), and the full Jest suite to confirm everything passes before resubmitting.
